_help: HOW TO EDIT: Each course is one {...} block inside the "courses" list. ADD: copy a block, paste after a comma, change the values. EDIT: change the text between quotes. REMOVE: delete the whole {...} block (and its comma). Keep every comma and quote. status must be Open, Closed or Coming Soon. featured true = shows on Home page. Check at jsonlint.com. The 3 records below are SAMPLES - replace them with real DRCT courses.

courses.name: Sample Course A (replace with real course)
courses.description: [Add a short description of what students will learn.]

courses.name: Sample Course B (replace with real course)
Sample Course C (replace with real course)
